prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Production-ready transparent-background 2.5D sprite atlas for the Amber Hive insect-civilization region of a bright fantasy action RPG.
Create ONE PNG with a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background. Regular uniform 5 columns x 4 rows, exactly 20 cells, ideally 3000 x 2400 pixels. No visible grid lines, labels, lettering, numbers, borders, floor tiles, backdrop, cast ground plane, water scenery or opaque contact-shadow squares. Every cell contains ONE complete separate isolated prop sprite. Leave at least 12% clear transparent gutter on all sides of each cell, and no pixels crossing cell boundaries. All objects centered horizontally, compact footprint touching a consistent low baseline within its cell. Smaller everyday props remain visually smaller than the pavilion landmarks, but every object must be fully inside its own cell. The last row must still be five separate sprites, not one connected scene.
Style: exquisite hand-painted cartoon fantasy with clean colored outlines, high-angle three-quarter near-isometric camera, convincing 2.5D volume, warm sunlight from upper left, gentle violet shaded sides. Fresh warm honey-cream, translucent amber, tender green leaves, vivid violet insect wing membranes, emerald gems. Insect civilization derives objects from wax honeycomb, shell, giant leaves, pollen and wings; playful imaginative fantasy mechanisms. No industrial mining equipment, winches, steel coils or dark rusty materials. The same camera angle and edge treatment across all 20 sprites.
Exact row-major content order, left to right:
ROW 1:
1. Amber glowworm lantern: a small cream beeswax three-foot stand holds a luminous golden amber capsule with emerald glowworm core, a violet petal fin and a leaf hood. Slender base, isolated complete object.
2. Pollen bell flower cluster: a short cluster of light green serrated leaves and three vivid purple bell-shaped flowers with yellow pollen, no dirt patch.
3. Insect wing banner: a slim amber-chitin pole on a small wax tripod carrying one translucent violet wing-shaped flag and green vein ornament. Keep the flag clear and delicate, no second object.
4. Beeswax spice market stall: a low honeycomb cream wax counter and small giant-leaf awning, tiny violet jars, golden pollen bowls and dew bottles. ONE connected miniature market stall, no ground slab.
5. Honey-crystal transport basket: rounded woven green-leaf basket reinforced with cream wax honeycomb pockets, filled with a few translucent amber crystal pieces, small handles, no conventional square mineral crate.
ROW 2:
6. Nectar sac jar: a bulbous translucent amber nectar sac held by a compact three-legged chitin base, green flower-petal cap and violet vein accent, one small object.
7. Honeycomb bench: a short cream wax stool/bench with two little honeycomb feet, a violet wing-membrane cushion and a small amber inset. Compact low shape, no floor.
8. Leaf sailboat: a small intact boat with folded giant-leaf hull, violet wing-membrane triangular sail, amber chitin mast and curled leaf prow. The boat alone, NO water, pier or platform beneath it.
9. Amber resin vein cluster: a LOW irregular branching translucent amber root-tube cluster with trapped golden pollen bubbles and two green leaf tips, compact free-standing organic ornament. No rectangular puddle or floor.
10. Leaf-wing entrance arch: a complete small open arch of curved light green leaf stems and pale chitin ribs, violet wing crest at top, slim independent feet. Arch interior and background are transparent, no hanging floor or wall behind it.
ROW 3:
11. Pollen flower treasure coffer: a vivid violet closed flower-like chest with amber heart lock, folded green sepals and small beetle feet. One jewel-box-sized object, no pedestal slab.
12. Honey-crystal pier landmark: a compact connected miniature pier structure made of wax ribs and woven leaf planks with two slim amber bollards and a small violet leaf canopy. Design as one prop silhouette with transparent space between supporting roots; no water, cliff, attached ground tile or sailboat.
13. Transparent cocoon display rack: a compact cream chitin frame holding three translucent empty oval cocoons on colorful violet silk ties, green-leaf top branch. A complete standalone rack with separate thin feet, no wall.
14. Wing observatory pavilion: a compact miniature pavilion with slim honey-wax supports, a violet wing-membrane fan canopy, large emerald-blue dragonfly compound-eye telescope at center and leaf details. A single landmark prop; no courtyard slab or surrounding scenery.
15. Chitin dancer memorial sculpture: cheerful graceful mantis dancer assembled from glossy orange-amber and jade chitin pieces on a VERY SMALL low wax plinth. It is a statue prop, not an enemy sprite, with violet wing accent.
ROW 4:
16. Molting ceremony display pavilion: three beautiful translucent amber EMPTY beetle-shell exuviae displayed in a connected low cream-wax framework with leafy rite crowns and violet cords. No living beetles, architecture wall or floor; empty shells visibly hollow.
17. Mantis leaf loom: a charming chitin loom shaped like bent mantis forelegs, weaving a vivid violet wing cloth with green giant-leaf edging and little dew-drop shuttle. A connected standalone craft station, no floor or person.
18. Pollen ventilation flower well: a compact giant golden flower-stamen and pollen-cup mechanism with green-and-violet open wind petals, pale honeycomb foot and an emerald nectar bubble. Organic flower machinery, NOT a metal fan or deep hole. One fully visible landmark prop.
19. Honeyflow calyx gate: an ornate open three-petal green flower-calyx gateway with translucent amber honey veins and a purple insect-wing crest. Two slim wax-root feet, clear transparent opening. No surrounding wall, water or courtyard.
20. Queen nursery crown throne: an empty grand insect queen throne made of a golden beeswax honeycomb crown, emerald egg-sac jewel, translucent violet wing backrest and giant green leaf supports. The throne alone, NO queen character, egg army, wall, floor or scene.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with alpha zero in all empty spaces; no matte color; no shadows cast onto imaginary floor; no text. Consistent warm bright fantasy material, independent objects, identical 5x4 cell layout, complete uncut silhouettes and transparent gutters. Avoid the look of photo-real metal or toy plastic; avoid huge bulky rock bases, industrial coils, conventional crates, floor stamps and connected multi-object scene panels.
